User collaborative code review focusing on concurrency 代码 review: User conducts code reviews collaboratively with teammates such as 李四 and 王五, often focusing on concurrency bugs in gateway code and tracking shared project intersections among collaborators.

User express project expectations express: When working on Express projects, the user expects a standard REST API setup with JWT authentication, CRUD endpoints, unified error-handling and request-logging middleware, and Jest unit tests that mock the database layer.
Concept: simu/ express 项目. The Express-based backend project under simu/ that the user asked to analyze and improve.
Concept: 分层结构. Project split into routes (paths/permissions), controller (validation/business/response) and store (data).
Concept: app.js 中间件顺序. Middleware registration order in app.js: requestLogger → rateLimit → body parsers → /health → /api → notFound → errorHandler.
Concept: ratelimit 中间件. Zero-dependency fixed-window limiter in middleware/rateLimit that counts per-IP hits in a Map.
Concept: 全局限流. Single app.use(rateLimit({windowMs: 60_000, max: 100})) in app.js covering all requests at 100/min per IP.
Concept: auth.routes.js. Auth route file with register/login handlers whose middleware chain has no dedicated rate limiter.
Concept: 固定窗口限流. Counting scheme storing count and resetAt per key, resetting after each 60s window.
Concept: 内存 map 存储. store.js data layer using an in-process Map, so data is lost on restart and not shared across instances.
Concept: 代码评审. Review session where the gateway code's concurrency bugs were found by 王五 and the user.
Concept: 独立限流. Dedicated per-endpoint rate limiting (e.g. rateLimit({max:5}) on POST /login) that the project lacks.
